facts.text: I am looking for new BBQ sauce recipes to try out.

I am excited to experiment with different types of wood and meats today.
I am thinking of trying a mix of hickory and apple wood today.
I have heard that hickory and apple wood pair well with pork and beef.

I have heard that you can use wood pellets as an alternative to logs, chips, or chunks.
I want to know what wood pellets are and how they compare to logs, chips, or chunks.

I want recommendations for good brands or types of wood pellets suitable for smoking meats.
